Class WindowsTerminal

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.backend.panama.windows.WindowsTerminal
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlatformTerminal, AutoCloseable
public final class WindowsTerminal extends Object implements PlatformTerminal
Windows terminal operations using Panama FFI.

This class provides higher-level terminal operations built on top of the low-level Kernel32 bindings.

    • enableRawMode

      public void enableRawMode() throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: PlatformTerminal
      Enables raw mode on the terminal.

      Raw mode disables line buffering, echo, and special character processing, allowing direct character-by-character input.

      Specified by:
      enableRawMode in interface PlatformTerminal
      Throws:
      IOException - if raw mode cannot be enabled

      public void write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: PlatformTerminal
      Writes a portion of a byte array to the terminal.

      This method allows writing from a reusable buffer without creating intermediate byte array copies.

      Specified by:
      write in interface PlatformTerminal
      Parameters:

      offset - the start offset in the buffer
      length - the number of bytes to write
